description: This file defines the BearerTokenAuthorization class which implements token authorization strategies for AWS SDK requests, specifically handling bearer tokens by adding authorization headers to HTTP requests.

classes.name: BearerTokenAuthorization
classes.description: Implements token-based authorization by injecting Bearer tokens into request headers.

methods.name: authorizeRequest
methods.description: Adds a Bearer token to the request's Authorization header after validating the token is present.
